seo.title: 31 Essential Tools for NFT Developers
seo.description: A curated list of tools for NFT developers covering smart contracts, metadata, art generation, and marketplace integration.

content.intro: NFT development spans smart contracts, art generation, metadata management, and marketplace integration. Here are the essential tools for each stage of NFT development.

sections.heading: Smart Contract Development
sections.description: Frameworks and libraries for NFT contracts.

items.name: OpenZeppelin ERC-721
items.description: Battle-tested ERC-721 implementation. The foundation for most NFT contracts.

items.name: ERC721A
items.description: Gas-optimized ERC-721 implementation from Azuki. Dramatically cheaper batch mints.

items.name: Solmate ERC-721
items.description: Minimalist, gas-optimized ERC-721. Good for custom implementations.

items.name: thirdweb NFT Contracts
items.description: Pre-built NFT contracts with drops, editions, and marketplace features.

sections.heading: Art Generation
sections.description: Tools for creating generative art collections.

items.name: HashLips Art Engine
items.description: Popular open-source generative art engine. Layer-based trait composition.

items.name: NFT Art Generator
items.description: Web-based generative art tool with rarity configuration. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

items.name: Processing
items.description: Creative coding environment. Great for algorithmic and generative art.

items.name: p5.js
items.description: JavaScript creative coding library. Browser-based generative art.

items.name: Canvas API
items.description: Native browser API for image generation. Full control over output.

sections.heading: Metadata and Storage
sections.description: Tools for managing NFT metadata and decentralized storage.

items.name: IPFS
items.description: Decentralized storage protocol. Standard for NFT metadata and images.

items.name: Pinata
items.description: IPFS pinning service with easy API. Ensures your content stays available.

items.name: NFT.Storage
items.description: Free IPFS storage for NFTs backed by Filecoin. Reliable long-term storage.

items.name: Arweave
items.description: Permanent decentralized storage. Pay once, store forever. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

items.name: Bundlr
items.description: Fast uploads to Arweave with multiple payment options. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

sections.heading: Allowlists and Distribution
sections.description: Tools for managing allowlists and fair launches.

items.name: Lanyard
items.description: Merkle tree API for allowlists. Easy integration for minting sites.

items.name: Premint
items.description: Allowlist management platform with raffles and social verification.

items.name: Bueno
items.description: No-code NFT creation platform with allowlists and minting pages.

items.name: Manifold
items.description: Creator tools for custom minting experiences and claims. Free and open-source.

sections.heading: Marketplace Integration
sections.description: Tools for marketplace compatibility and trading.

items.name: OpenSea SDK
items.description: SDK for OpenSea integration. List, buy, and manage NFTs programmatically.

items.name: Reservoir
items.description: NFT liquidity aggregator. Single API for all major marketplaces.

items.name: Blur API
items.description: API for Blur marketplace integration. Worth evaluating for your workflow.

items.name: LooksRare SDK
items.description: SDK for LooksRare marketplace integration. Free and open-source.

sections.heading: Analytics and Data
sections.description: Tools for NFT analytics and tracking.

items.name: Alchemy NFT API
items.description: Comprehensive NFT API. Get ownership, metadata, and floor prices.

items.name: OpenSea API
items.description: Access OpenSea data including collections, events, and listings.

items.name: NFTGo
items.description: NFT analytics platform with rarity, whales, and market data.

items.name: Rarity Tools
items.description: Rarity rankings for NFT collections. Worth evaluating for your workflow.

sections.heading: Verification and Security
sections.description: Tools for contract verification and security.

items.name: Etherscan Verification
items.description: Verify contract source code. Essential for trust and transparency.

items.name: OpenZeppelin MerkleProof
items.description: Library for Merkle proof verification. Use for allowlists. Free and open-source.

items.name: Chainlink VRF
items.description: Verifiable random function. Fair and unpredictable NFT reveals.

items.name: Tenderly
items.description: Smart contract debugging and simulation. Debug failed mints.

items.name: Sourcify
items.description: Decentralized contract verification alternative to Etherscan.

proTips.tip: Use ERC721A for collections expecting batch mints. Gas savings are substantial.
Always pin metadata to multiple IPFS providers or use Arweave for permanent storage.
Test metadata rendering on OpenSea testnet before mainnet. Quirks in display are common.
Use Merkle trees for allowlists. They're gas-efficient and can't be front-run.
Set up provenance hash before mint starts. It proves art was finalized before minting.
